about: Nordic brews. Bought with points at the shrine; the blessing takes effect at once. They stack: take each as often as you can pay for. Death takes them all. Each class has its own three (cls), offered only to that class at the altar; the rest are shared.

rows.label: Troll's Hide Mead
rows.description: +50 maximum health.

rows.label: Wellspring Draught
rows.description: +50 maximum magicka.

rows.label: Stormrunner Brew
rows.description: You move 15% faster.

rows.label: Bounty Hunter's Ale
rows.description: Elites and mini-bosses give twice the Cursed Essence.

rows.label: Last Stand Ale
rows.description: Below 25% health, you take 25% less damage.

rows.label: Gilded Tongue Tonic
rows.description: +15% Cursed Essence from kills.

rows.label: Dragonsblood Cider
rows.description: Your shouts recharge 25% faster.

rows.label: Pack Leader Mead
rows.description: You can have one more summon out at a time.

rows.label: Grave Fury Wine
rows.description: Your summons deal 25% more damage.

rows.label: Bone Burst Brew
rows.description: When one of your summons dies it explodes, hurting the enemies around it.

rows.label: Overflow Tea
rows.description: Every 3rd Destruction spell you cast is free.

rows.label: Ember Echo Ale
rows.description: Enemies you kill with Destruction spells explode, hurting the enemies around them.

rows.label: Mana Font Draught
rows.description: Your magicka refills 40% faster.

rows.label: Volatile Tincture
rows.description: Your flasks' bursts reach 25% wider.

rows.label: Quickhand Elixir
rows.description: You throw your flasks 25% faster.

rows.label: Catalyst Philter
rows.description: Enemies hit by one of your flasks take 15% more damage for 5 seconds.

rows.label: Bladesong Mead
rows.description: Each melee hit you land on an enemy heals you 5% of your maximum health.

rows.label: Spellbinder's Draught
rows.description: The spell carried on your blade hits 25% harder.

rows.label: Spellguard Ale
rows.description: Blocking costs no stamina.

rows.label: Quick Revive Draught
rows.description: Revive friends twice as fast. Fall once and you rise where you stand - the draught is spent and its slot opens again.

limits.note: (Noah, 2026-11-11: "more slots each step" - 1 slot from night 3, 2 from night 7, 3 from night 12, 4 from night 18; shown as faint outlines above the health bar)
